# tools/pm — logq prompt-manager

`tools/pm` is the source of truth for generated agent/operator docs. Content
lives in `sources/**`, is stitched by `targets.yaml`, and rendered through
Jinja2 templates into `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.codex/*`, and `.cursorrules`.

## Source-of-truth rule

- Edit only `tools/pm/sources/**` (and, when the mechanism changes,
  `templates/` and `targets.yaml`).
- Never hand-edit generated outputs. They are overwritten on `sync` and carry a
  "DO NOT EDIT — generated by tools/pm" banner.

| Target | Output |
| --- | --- |
| `agents` | `AGENTS.md` |
| `claude` | `CLAUDE.md` |
| `codex_rules` | `.codex/CODEX-RULES.md` |
| `codex_start` | `.codex/CODEX-START-PROMPT.md` |
| `cursor_rules` | `.cursorrules` |

## Commands

```bash
uv run python tools/pm/pm.py sync
uv run python tools/pm/pm.py lint
uv run python tools/pm/pm.py status
uv run python tools/pm/pm.py preview --target agents
```

Without `uv`:

```bash
python3 tools/pm/pm.py sync
```

## Drift-lint contract

`pm lint` re-renders every target in memory and compares it to the on-disk file.
It exits non-zero if any target drifted or is missing.

## Layout

```text
tools/pm/
  pm.py
  targets.yaml
  sources/
    rules/
    operational/
    agent-specific/
  templates/
  tests/
```
